+<testcase>
+<info>
+<keywords>
+FTP

+</data>

+# Client-side
+<client>
+<server>
+ftp
+</server>
+<tool>
+lib576
+</tool>
+<name>
+FTP wildcard with pattern ending with an open-bracket
+</name>

+"ftp://%HOSTIP:%FTPPORT/fully_simulated/DOS/*[]["

+USER anonymous

+PWD
+CWD fully_simulated
+CWD DOS
+EPSV

+LIST
